recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future BiologicallyDerivedProduct modeling changes should be handled through later, more specific Jira issues rather than by reapplying FHIR-33068 literally.
issue_request: FHIR-33068 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked to add a repeating BiologicallyDerivedProduct.property backbone for MPHO-specific information, with property.type as CodeableConcept and property.value[x] as a required choice, while also updating the resource definition and key instance-oriented attributes.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation: commit a261b7c6662ea3b212f0c8e20c83c3ada67cbee1 updated the BiologicallyDerivedProduct resource and example for FHIR-33068, and d33f73f4e8641b29bbfda1c109068dfd0ab5321f corrected the property.type binding URL cited in the Jira application comment.
additional_context: BiologicallyDerivedProduct is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition retains the FHIR-33068 semantics while reflecting later applied work: FHIR-33395 expanded property.value[x], FHIR-37199 renamed the source traceability element to biologicalSourceEvent, and FHIR-36795 renamed status to productStatus. OO HCP minutes on 2021-08-23 support the current instance-oriented interpretation.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. The authoritative source already contains the requested instance wording, traceability/storage elements, and 0..* property backbone with property.type 1..1 CodeableConcept and property.value[x] 1..1 typed choices; reverting current names or types to the literal Jira table would conflict with later accepted changes.
